m2_criterion.definition: Current rights-cleared Sri Lanka Post or legally authorised five-digit string assignments, with declared post-office/locality scope and temporal validity, are joined to independently licensed source-linked point, route or area geometry (or explicit none without a spatial lookup claim). Reproducible coverage, exception, CRS/topology and privacy checks must validate real scoped records and approved immutable digest-pinned artifacts through the actual AGID loader/API. Preserve Sinhala, Tamil and English names, leading zeros, separate GN/DS/census identifiers and official/derived/virtual/none authority; exact civic/building display needs an independent explicit permitted relation.

definition_basis.rule: Country-specific initial definition from current operator syntax/form and independent NSDI metadata. No existing M2 definition is overwritten; administrative geometry is not made into postal geometry.

references.title: Department of Posts | තැපැල් සංකේත
references.reviewed_scope: Five-digit postal sorting/delivery syntax, introduced in 1997; same-name places need context. Explanatory page, not a data edition or machine API.

references.title: Department of Posts | Postcodes
references.reviewed_scope: English operator explanation of five-digit syntax and ambiguous place names. Directory purchase mentioned, not initiated; historical price is not a current offer.

references.title: Boundaries | Sri Lanka NSDI
references.reviewed_scope: Boundary category and WMS discovery reference, not a postal boundary dataset or reuse licence.

references.title: What are the classifications of data? | Sri Lanka NSDI
references.reviewed_scope: Shareable/non-shareable classification and metadata/access-policy requirements; not blanket permission. Site footer reserves rights.

references.title: Survey Department of Sri Lanka | Sri Lanka NSDI
references.reviewed_scope: Agency survey, cadastral and mapping remit. Mentioned building/topographic products are not public civic/building relations or current coverage.

references.title: Home | Data Protection Authority
references.reviewed_scope: Authority references the 2022 Act and 2025 amendment. A homepage news date does not establish current commencement or legal applicability; no legal-status or licence clearance.

rights_review.operator: Read-only public initial HTML and explanation observed; no current editioned rights-cleared national assignment release or bulk/derivative redistribution permission. Form options are not coverage. No POST or directory purchase.
rights_review.geometry: NSDI category and five administrative layer schemas observed; blank copyright and query capabilities grant no licence. FAQ distinguishes shareable/non-shareable data. No feature query or geometry acquired; no administrative/census identifier is a postcode.
rights_review.privacy: GN metadata exposes gnd_officer_name and gnd_officer_phone; values are not fetched. Exclude personal/contact/free-text/recipient/owner/title data by explicit allowlist before any future intake; forbid outFields=* and sensitive-layer queries. DPA homepage is a legal-review reference, not clearance.
rights_review.availability: Survey root returned 406 and data.gov.lk endpoints failed direct retrieval in preflight. Failures do not establish absence. Draft policy is not enacted law or per-dataset permission.
